title: Video by overkill_kulture
description:
We have everything we need to quit feeding  the machine and make our own machine

I’m gonna make this prototype over here in Sandpoint and it’s gonna grow like wildfire.

We’re gonna hit copy and give this blueprint to every community building something similar across the world .

There’s no reason why the hub which is a shared maker space that is gonna run the 13 pillars shouldn’t be in every city 

We’re gonna have computer software to track every member of the community consciousness, advancement, and real world alterations. 

That’s the biggest problem is working together as a team and we can use pattern theory to make sure we don’t any #destroyers 

Wouldn’t it be great to turn all of the plastic into houses? I don’t want it to smell like plastic on the inside…. We need cedar or something. I don’t know. We’ll figure that out!! 

#builderrevolution #buildyourwayout
